alt: Two box plots stacked on a shared number line of commute times in minutes running from 0 to 50, marked every 10. Route A is the upper plot: minimum 12, lower quartile 20, median 22, upper quartile 28, maximum 40. Route B is the lower plot: minimum 8, lower quartile 18, median 30, upper quartile 36, maximum 46. Route B's median is higher and its box and whiskers span a wider range.
